name: 3M ELITE v1
description: Partial implementation of the SPENNYFX 3M SYSTEM CHECKLIST, scaled to a 3-minute entry using the authors' own ratios: 12H bias, 3H supply/demand zone, 48m structure, 3m entry. All higher timeframes are reconstructed from 1m bars by timestamp arithmetic. Implemented: structural bias per layer, break counting with the 6/4 caps, zone tap, Keltner overextension from the 20MA, MAs-not-fully-against-bias, and the 20/50 slope gate. Risk uses a structural stop at the 3H zone edge with the source's own ATR take-profit method (12x ATR), both fixed at entry.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// 3M ELITE v1 — BTCUSDT, 1m base chart.
// Cascade per the 3M SYSTEM CHECKLIST, scaled to a 3-minute entry using the authors' own ratios:
//   BIAS 12H -> ZONE 3H -> STRUCTURE 48m -> ENTRY 3m
// Every higher timeframe is rebuilt from 1m timestamps (exact: a 3m candle IS 3 consecutive 1m bars).
//
// IMPLEMENTED from the checklists: model/structural bias, break counting with caps, supply/demand
// zone tap, Keltner overextension from the 20MA, MA stack not fully against bias, 20/50 slope gate,
// structural stop, ATR take-profit (the source's 12x ATR method).
// NOT IMPLEMENTED (undefined in the checklists, needs the videos): Type 1/Type 2 validation,
// the swing rule, and the stage gate. This is therefore a PARTIAL implementation.
strategy("3M ELITE v1", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

maxBreakHi = input.int(6,    "Max breaks on bias/zone/structure")
maxBreakEn = input.int(4,    "Max breaks on the entry timeframe")
kcMult     = input.float(2.0,"Keltner width for overextension, x ATR")
slopeLen   = input.int(10,   "Bars used for MA slope")
zoneTolK   = input.float(0.25,"Zone tap tolerance, x atr(30)")
bufK       = input.float(0.25,"Structural stop buffer, x atr(30)")
tpATR      = input.float(12.0,"Take profit, x ATR (source's ATR method)")
minRpct    = input.float(0.80,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct    = input.float(3.00,"Max risk as % of price")
maxBars    = input.int(1440, "Max bars in trade")

MS3M  = 180000
MS48M = 2880000
MS3H  = 10800000
MS12H = 43200000

b3   = math.floor(time / MS3M)
b48  = math.floor(time / MS48M)
b3h  = math.floor(time / MS3H)
b12h = math.floor(time / MS12H)

new3   = b3   != b3[1]
new48  = b48  != b48[1]
new3h  = b3h  != b3h[1]
new12h = b12h != b12h[1]

// ---------- reconstructed candles: open/high/low, and the previous completed close ----------
var float o3 = na
var float h3 = na
var float l3 = na
var float c3prev = na
var float c3prev2 = na
if new3
    c3prev2 := c3prev
    c3prev  := close[1]
    o3 := open
    h3 := high
    l3 := low
else
    h3 := na(h3) ? high : math.max(h3, high)
    l3 := na(l3) ? low  : math.min(l3, low)

var float h48 = na
var float l48 = na
var float c48prev = na
var float c48prev2 = na
if new48
    c48prev2 := c48prev
    c48prev  := close[1]
    h48 := high
    l48 := low
else
    h48 := na(h48) ? high : math.max(h48, high)
    l48 := na(l48) ? low  : math.min(l48, low)

var float c3hH = na
var float c3hL = na
var float p3hH = na
var float p3hL = na
var float c3hprev = na
var float c3hprev2 = na
if new3h
    c3hprev2 := c3hprev
    c3hprev  := close[1]
    p3hH := c3hH
    p3hL := c3hL
    c3hH := high
    c3hL := low
else
    c3hH := na(c3hH) ? high : math.max(c3hH, high)
    c3hL := na(c3hL) ? low  : math.min(c3hL, low)

var float c12prev = na
var float c12prev2 = na
if new12h
    c12prev2 := c12prev
    c12prev  := close[1]

// ---------- LAYER 1: BIAS (12H) model = two consecutive same-direction closes ----------
biasBull = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev > c12prev2
biasBear = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev < c12prev2

// ---------- LAYER 2: ZONE (3H) model agrees + supply/demand tap ----------
zoneBull = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev > c3hprev2
zoneBear = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev < c3hprev2

atr30 = ta.atr(30)
tol   = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * zoneTolK
// demand tap: price trades back down into the previous completed 3H candle's low area
demandTap = not na(p3hL) and low  <= p3hL + tol
supplyTap = not na(p3hH) and high >= p3hH - tol

// ---------- LAYER 3: STRUCTURE (48m) model agrees ----------
structBull = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev > c48prev2
structBear = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev < c48prev2

// ---------- break counting: a break is a close beyond the prior 20-bar extreme ----------
brkUpLvl = ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
brkDnLvl = ta.lowest(low,  20)[1]
brokeUp  = ta.crossover(close, brkUpLvl)
brokeDn  = ta.crossunder(close, brkDnLvl)
var int upCount = 0
var int dnCount = 0
if brokeUp
    upCount := upCount + 1
    dnCount := 0
if brokeDn
    dnCount := dnCount + 1
    upCount := 0

// ---------- MAs on the entry timeframe ----------
ma20  = ta.ema(close, 20)
ma50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
ma200 = ta.ema(close, 200)

// Keltner overextension around the 20MA (the 30SEC checklist names Keltner explicitly)
atr14  = ta.atr(14)
kcUp   = ma20 + kcMult * atr14
kcDn   = ma20 - kcMult * atr14
notExtLong  = close < kcUp
notExtShort = close > kcDn

// MAs not FULLY against bias: all three stacked the wrong way is the veto
fullyAgainstLong  = ma20 < ma50 and ma50 < ma200
fullyAgainstShort = ma20 > ma50 and ma50 > ma200

// 20 & 50 not overextended from the 200
maSpreadOk = not na(ma200) and ma200 > 0 and math.abs(ma20 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0 and math.abs(ma50 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0

// slope gate: either the 20 or the 50 must favour the trade
slope20Up = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 > ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Up = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 > ma50[slopeLen]
slope20Dn = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 < ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Dn = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 < ma50[slopeLen]
slopeOkLong  = slope20Up or slope50Up
slopeOkShort = slope20Dn or slope50Dn

// ---------- the gated cascade ----------
longStack  = biasBull and zoneBull and structBull and demandTap and notExtLong  and not fullyAgainstLong  and maSpreadOk and slopeOkLong  and upCount <= maxBreakEn and dnCount <= maxBreakHi
shortStack = biasBear and zoneBear and structBear and supplyTap and notExtShort and not fullyAgainstShort and maSpreadOk and slopeOkShort and dnCount <= maxBreakEn and upCount <= maxBreakHi

// entry trigger on the 3m close, in the direction of bias
goLong  = longStack  and new3 and close > o3
goShort = shortStack and new3 and close < o3

// ---------- risk: structural stop beyond the zone, ATR take profit per the source ----------
buf  = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * bufK
minR = close * minRpct / 100
maxR = close * maxRpct / 100

rawLongR  = na(p3hL) ? na : close - (p3hL - buf)
rawShortR = na(p3hH) ? na : (p3hH + buf) - close
longR     = na(rawLongR)  ? na : math.min(math.max(rawLongR,  minR), maxR)
shortR    = na(rawShortR) ? na : math.min(math.max(rawShortR, minR), maxR)

var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

if flat and goLong and not na(longR) and longR > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - longR
    tpPx   := close + atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and goShort and not na(shortR) and shortR > 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + shortR
    tpPx   := close - atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(biasBull ? 1 : biasBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Bias12H")
plot(zoneBull ? 1 : zoneBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Zone3H")
plot(structBull ? 1 : structBear ? -1 : 0, title="Struct48m")
plot(upCount,                              title="BreaksUp")
plot(dnCount,                              title="BreaksDown")
notes: FIRST BUILD, PARTIAL IMPLEMENTATION. Three checklist gates are undefined in the PDFs and are NOT implemented: Type 1/Type 2 validation, the swing rule, and the stage gate. Their absence is the most likely reason this understates the real system, so read PF 0.91 as a lower bound, not a verdict. Leg split: longs 8 trades (6 winners, 75%, +$186), shorts 12 (2 winners, 16.7%, -$228) -- the long side is already strongly positive on a tiny sample and the short side is the loser, the same pattern as every other strategy in this project. Only 20 trades over 4.6 months because 1m coverage is all the engine has. avgBarsWinning 268 vs avgBarsLosing 47: winners run, losers get cut, which is what the 12x ATR target is designed to do.

name: 3M ELITE v3 (15m base port)
description: The same cascade and the same ladder ratios as v1, ported one zoom level up to a 15m entry: structure 4H, zone 12H, bias 2D. The author scales his own system this way between his 15sec and 30sec variants. No new filters were added -- this run exists purely to escape the 4.6-month 1m data limit and measure the cascade on 4.7 years instead.
notes: THIS SUPERSEDES v1 AS THE REFERENCE MEASUREMENT, despite the lower profit factor. v1 showed PF 0.91 on 20 trades across 4.6 months; v3 shows PF 0.64 on 94 trades across 4.7 years of the SAME cascade. The larger sample is the trustworthy one, and it says v1's 0.91 was noise. Leg split: longs 35 trades (10 winners, 28.6%, -$576), shorts 59 (5 winners, 8.5%, -$820) -- both lose, shorts much worse, the same pattern as every short in this project. Payoff ratio 3.37:1 needs ~23% wins to break even and delivered 16.0%. This is the sample-size fix doing its job: it did not improve the strategy, it revealed that the earlier number was not evidence. Gates can now be tested against a base with a usable trade count.

name: 3M ELITE v5 latched tap + Type 2 validation
description: Queue item 0-V5. The zone tap now LATCHES instead of being required on the entry bar, and the latch lives until the zone invalidates (a completed 12H candle whose body closes beyond it). While the latch is live, an engulfing 4H candle in the direction of bias fires the entry. This merges queue items 0a and 0b into one mechanism and fixes the HARD LESSON 8 defect behind v2 and v4.
notes: THE LATCH WORKS BUT A SECOND SIMULTANEITY BUG REMAINS. 2 trades over 4.7 years, both losses -- a meaningless sample, recorded for provenance, NOT evidence about the strategy. The progress is real: v2 and v4 produced zero trades and this produced some, so latching the tap fixed the defect it was meant to fix. The remaining defect is the same shape one level down. validBull is true for exactly ONE bar every four hours, the instant a new 4H candle opens behind an engulfing one, and every other gate (bias, zone, structure, slope, extension, break counts) must happen to be true on that same bar. The VALIDATION must latch too. In the source a validation persists until the zone invalidates -- it is a state, not an instant. v6 latches both.

name: 3M ELITE v6 tap and validation both latched
description: Queue item 0-V6. Both the zone tap and the Type 2 engulfing validation are persistent states that die together when a completed 12H candle body closes beyond the zone. Entry fires on the first bar where both are live and the trend and extension gates permit. Type 2 only; Type 1 (the 3M candle) is still undefined in the source.
notes: FIRST POSITIVE RESULT IN THIS LAB, AND EXPLICITLY NOT YET EVIDENCE. PF 1.77, net +3.10%, longs 5 (2 wins, +$297.97), shorts 5 (1 win, +$12.05) -- both legs positive, the short essentially flat. The mechanism finally behaves as the source describes: zero trades at v2 and v4, 2 at v5, 10 here. But TEN TRADES IN 4.7 YEARS IS NOT A SAMPLE. This lab has already been burned by exactly this: v1 showed PF 0.91 on 20 trades and the same cascade on a proper sample gave PF 0.64 on 94. The honest reading is that the mechanism is now correctly implemented and the frequency is still far too low to test it. Do NOT promote this over v3 as the reference base on these numbers.

name: 3M ELITE v7 source rules only
description: Queue item 0-V7, run as a measurement. The four lab-invented gates (MA-spread test, break counters, MA slope test, Keltner overextension check) are removed, leaving only the author's own rules: 2D bias, 12H zone, 4H structure, the latched tap and the Type 2 validation. Tests whether the 10-trade frequency of v6 was caused by my additions.
notes: THE MEASUREMENT ANSWERED, AND THE ANSWER WAS NOT WHAT I EXPECTED. Removing four gates left the trade count at exactly 10, unchanged from v6 (still 5 long, 5 short). My additions were NOT binding. The frequency ceiling comes from the SOURCE-derived conjunction itself -- 2D bias, 12H zone and 4H structure all having to rise together while a tap and a validation are both live. PF fell 1.77->1.32 on the same tiny sample, which is noise either way and is not a reason to keep the invented gates. The next question is therefore a specification question, not a tuning one: requiring bias, zone AND structure to agree may be my reading of 'direction' rather than his, and the latched tap plus validation may already encode the location those three were meant to establish.

name: 3M ELITE v9 engulfing-created zones
description: First build on the corrected model. An engulfing 4H candle CREATES a zone spanning it plus the following candle; the zone stays unmitigated until a second 4H candle enters it (the One Candle Rule); entry is the first return into a live zone with the 2D bias agreeing. Replaces the inverted model in v1-v7. Both legs from the author's symmetric definition, reported separately.
notes: THE MODEL IS RIGHT; THE SINGLE-SLOT APPROXIMATION IS WRONG, AND I FLAGGED IT BEFORE RUNNING. 3 trades (2 long, 1 short), down from v6's 10. The cause is precisely the deviation declared in the source comment: Pine forbids arrays, so only ONE zone per side is tracked and every new engulfing candle overwrites the previous zone. In a trending market engulfing candles arrive every few 4H bars, so a zone is almost never still alive when price returns to it. The source says to trade the DEEPEST UNMITIGATED zone, which presupposes several being tracked at once. Fix in v10 is one line and follows the source directly: replace the tracked zone only when the new one is DEEPER (lower bottom for demand, higher top for supply), or when the current one is dead. Do not read PF 0.64 on 3 trades as information about the model.

name: 3M ELITE v10 deepest unmitigated zone
description: Queue item 0-V10. One line changed from v9: a new engulfing candle replaces the tracked zone only if it is deeper (lower bottom for demand, higher top for supply) or the tracked zone is already dead, implementing the source's deepest unmitigated zone. Both legs reported separately.
notes: IDENTICAL TO v9 IN EVERY FIGURE, AND THAT IS THE DIAGNOSIS. Same PF 0.64013804, same 3 trades, same net. If overwriting had been the cause of v9's scarcity, requiring the new zone to be deeper would have changed something. It changed nothing, which proves the selection rule never fires: zones are already DEAD by the time the next engulfing candle arrives, so the guard clause always sees a dead zone and replaces it exactly as v9 did. THE REAL DEFECT IS THE ZONE GEOMETRY. I defined a demand zone as the engulfing candle's whole high-to-low range, so the zone TOP equals the impulse high -- price is inside the zone the instant the candle closes. The mitigation test then trips within two candles every time. In supply and demand a zone is the BASE the impulse left behind, not the impulse itself. v11 must fix the geometry before any selection rule can matter.

name: 3M ELITE v11 corrected zone geometry
description: Queue item 0-V11. The zone is redefined as the BASE the impulse left behind -- demand [low, open] of the bullish engulfing candle, supply [open, high] of the bearish one -- rather than the candle's whole range. Both legs reported separately.
notes: THE GEOMETRY FIX WAS REAL BUT IT WAS NOT THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. Still 3 trades, though the composition changed (1 long 2 short, against v10's 2 long 1 short), which confirms the code genuinely behaves differently. THREE SUCCESSIVE STRUCTURAL FIXES HAVE NOW ALL LANDED ON ROUGHLY THREE TRADES -- v9 the latched model, v10 the deepest-zone rule, v11 the base geometry. When three independent corrections produce the same trade count, the limiting factor is upstream of all of them. STOP GUESSING AND MEASURE: v12 must be a DIAGNOSTIC that strips the entry to nothing but 'a zone is live and price is inside it', with no bias, no direction and no candle-colour condition, purely to count how many opportunities exist at all. Filtering a population before knowing its size is what produced these last three cycles.
